# Noto Emoji

The Sumigo icon (🦑, `emoji_u1f991.svg`) comes from [Noto Emoji](https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-emoji) by Google, licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (copy in [LICENSE](LICENSE)).

Used as-is in `web/public/favicon.svg` and `docs/static/img/favicon.svg`. The PNG app icons in `web/public/` are renderings of it, at several sizes and on a plain background for the maskable and Apple touch icons.
